reason: The cited evidence shows that lamellar FCC/B2 microstructures can enhance strength (E1) and that hot rolling improves ductility in lightweight MEAs (E2), but neither study involves the Nb–Ti–Al–Zr system, high-temperature testing, or the specific processing–property relationship claimed, leaving most key premises unsupported.
